title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix Club on 1966-12-01

ai_review.summary: Cleaned‑up soundboard of the Dec 1 1966 Matrix show captures a solid early‑Dead performance highlighted by a stellar Alice D. Millionaire.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this early‑Dead set, noting the band’s good form and strong communication with the audience, and singling out the version of “Alice D. Millionaire” as a favorite. The newer source eliminates the original tape hiss, though some high‑end sparkle is missing and a few tracks are slightly mis‑ordered. Overall it’s an enjoyable listening experience for lovers of the 1966 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and the cleaned‑up soundboard, with only minor technical quirks; strong positive sentiment across many detailed comments supports a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original hiss removed in newer source but high‑end frequencies are reduced; some reviewers note a few songs are mixed up in order, but overall clarity is solid for an early SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set early‑Dead set at the Matrix with a mix of blues, folk‑rock and originals; band is in good form and engages the audience throughout.
